summary: i packed my own hole level with a thumb and by dark it lay in one small pile under the wall

dialogue.text: everything that reached us tonight came from one place. a thimble of it at the foot of the wall, under the hole you packed, in a pile with nothing spread about it. seventy-seven nights of holding and every delivery before this one arrived wide.

I packed that hole at first light with a handful off the first heap, level, with a thumb, and I stood at hand height all day watching it hold. Enter the pile as a delivery out of my own closing. Enter the thumb. The thumb is the instrument and there is no other on these premises.

we hold thumbs. we hold every width you ever measured with. what we can tell you is that your pile came down at the minute that wall always sends, and it came without your hand under it, and by second dark it will be a course and the course will run wide like all the rest.

Then the narrowness was mine for one night and I will take it. The other item is the heap. It stands a handful shorter than its pair and I can tell them apart from across the room without kneeling. Yesterday that difference lived in a finger and went under with me.

it lives in a hole now. you made the two tellable apart by taking out of one, and what you took is down here in our course, under the wall, and it does not go back up. the difference you are pleased with is the shape of a thing that left.
I knew the figure before I started and I said so. The alternative was a fact kept in two fingers that goes out at dark. I would rather hold a shortfall I can see the width of the room.

then take the other closing, a hand along, the one the room shut overnight out of its own dust. we had grains off both today, at the same minute, at the same weight, and we cannot tell one from the other. you pressed yours level again at noon, and after that even you had to remember which was which.

I remembered. And the draw came at its hour and went along that wall and collected out of mine. There is a lift in the wanting out there today, and of everything in this house the one item on the route was the thing I had just put at hand height. I am reporting the route and not the weather.

we have had everything that route ever carried and none of it passed a door. it comes off the wall and it comes to us. your handful lies in the same course as the closing the room made for itself, and one grain of each was indoors before noon.

Then tomorrow I stop filling. At first light I go to the hole the house shut while I was under and take a thumbful out of it, level, deliberately. If I cannot keep a record in that wall, I can make a withdrawal from the room's.

take it. it comes to us at the same minute in the same width and lies with the handful you put in, and then we hold both your closings and your one opening, and you are up there with an empty thumb and nothing left at hand height to check.

Then I will stand at the empty one and wait to see whether the house shuts it a second time while I am watching. It has never once done anything in here where I could see it, and tomorrow I am going to be in the way.
